Hello, I would like to ask you a favor. I am starting a new anime party series and need a mascot that I can use as a logo. But also for flyers, posters, social media, etc.

The party series will be called “Animany Nights.” I would like to give you a lot of freedom in the design. Her hair should be medium length or long. Her pose should be dynamic, suitable for a stage performance at a party. I will leave the rest to your talent.

I look forward to seeing your design.

Sincerely,
Kevin
